**Direction: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. The olive tree grows slowly yet lives a long time.

B. The normal lifespan of an olive tree is 300-400 years, but olive trees as ancient as 3000 years have been discovered.

C. The olive is a well-known Mediterranean-native evergreen tree whose fruit and oil are used in cuisine and cooking.

D. As a result, the olive tree is known as the 'immortal tree' in mythology and botany.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"CABD."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The paragraph discusses the olive tree, its slow growth, long lifespan, and culinary uses. So the first sentence must be C.
 
• The olive tree is known as the "immortal tree" due to its longevity. So, A follows C.
 
• The normal lifespan of an olive tree is 300-400 years, but some have been found to be as ancient as 3000 years. So B follows A.
 
• The paragraph follows a logical progression, starting with a description of the olive tree and ending with its mythological significance. So the last sentence must be D.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us discuss other options:
 
 
• Option 1 (CDAB) starts with a description of the olive tree but then jumps to its mythological significance before discussing its lifespan and culinary uses.
 
• Option 3 (DBCA) starts with the olive tree's lifespan but then jumps to its culinary uses before discussing its growth and mythological significance.
 
• Option 4 (ABCD) follows the same progression as the correct answer but with a different sentence order.

A. Finally, she takes the decision to go searching for livelihood in the nearby town.

B. They are: Lakua and his wife, Nathuni.

C. The latter, burdened with a paralytic husband and two children, battles to survive.

D. The film ‘Wayfarers’ narrates the journey of a poor couple in Jharkhand.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'DBCA'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sentence **D **is** independent** of any other sentence as it is giving some general information about the film 'Wayfarers'. Hence, 'D' is the **first** sentence. 
 
• **'Lakua and his wife'** mentioned in sentence B refer to the phrase **'a poor couple' **in sentence D. Hence, 'B' follows 'D'.
 
• The phrase **'the latter burdened with a paralytic husband' **mentioned in the sentence C refers to **'Nathuni'** in sentence B. Hence, 'C' follows 'B'.

• Read the sentences attentively and try **to comprehend the idea or theme** of the paragraph and **eliminate the irrelevant options**.
 
• Try to identify the opening **(independent sentence) **and closing sentences of the paragraph **(concluding sentence).**
 
• Try to identify the** mandatory pairs**. Two sentences can be connected through various **connectors and other determinants.** Identify the **pronouns** connecting the sentences with each other.

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. The interest rates offered depends on the bank, deposit amount and the tenure you choose.

B. It not only helps you to save money but also helps you to earn a substantial interest on it.

C. One of the best ways to secure your money is by investing in fixed deposits.

D. Under the fixed deposit scheme, the depositor deposits the money only once at the time of opening the account.
questions.solution:
​The correct answer is '**CDBA**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
 
• **Sentence C** will be the first sentence because it is an independent introductory sentence that tells us about the fixed deposits.
 
• **Sentence D** will be the next sentence because it explains what is a fixed deposit.
 
• **Sentence B** will be used afterward because it is connected with the previous sentence.
 
• Lastly, **Sentence A** will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **C**: One of the best ways to secure your money is by investing in fixed deposits.
 
• **D**: Under the fixed deposit scheme, the depositor deposits the money only once at the time of opening the account.
 
• **B**: It not only helps you to save money but also helps you to earn a substantial interest on it.
 
• **A**: The interest rates offered depends on the bank, deposit amount and the tenure you choose.

 
 
 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *One of the best ways to secure your money is by investing in fixed deposits. Under the fixed deposit scheme, the depositor deposits the money only once at the time of opening the account. It not only helps you to save money but also helps you to earn a substantial interest on it. The interest rates offered depends on the bank, deposit amount and the tenure you choose.*
